rules.custodyModel: Owner-controlled local store outside every repo; separate provider ID/namespace/restricted OS principal from business. Configuration metadata only; no actual provider, principal, ACL or store provisioned.
rules.loaderIsolation: Fixed BUSINESS and MAINTENANCE wrappers; WeakMap-branded synthetic scoped ports; opposite role/namespace and forged JSON denied. AST imports/re-exports/literal require/dynamic import traversal; cross-import/unrestricted accessor/helper/computed imports denied. Actual current business signer graph parsed read-only, not executed.
rules.seedLocationPolicy: Never repo, Slack, Vercel, frontend env, Supabase, logs/reports or fixtures. Non-local providers, forbidden path components and existing .git ancestors rejected; only design metadata examined.
rules.creationManifest: creation.schema.json / creationManifest: public maintenance key, network ID, creation ledger/hash/timestamp, observed S0, master/weight/thresholds/sponsorship, Friendbot source, owner reference, business/evidence/TTL identities. Synthetic reused public address; no real key generation.
rules.S0: Freeze independently observed initial post-creation sequence and creation-manifest hash. Do not infer attempt count from sequence alone.
rules.sequenceAnchor: 0 <= seq_live-S0 <=3; equals all included maintenance SUCCESS+FAILED records. Exact contiguous sequence/hash/envelope/source/RO/RW correlation. Captured mode verifies existing master signature. No unrelated account activity, bumpSequence, payment, fee bump or extra op.
rules.accountHistoryBoundary: Future authenticated adapter must prove complete pagination from S0/creation, with the known creation/funding transaction separately verified as the base event. No other incoming/unrelated tx may be hidden. Offline completeSinceCreation labels are not network evidence.
rules.appendOnlyDataModel: record ID/previous hash/hash/index/time/action, RUN/scope/owner gate, simulation and extend reservation IDs, original hash/status, business remaining, all counters, sequence/S0/network/identities/creation hash/detail. Unknown release/retry/replacement/rebroadcast actions fail.
rules.hashChain: SHA256(UTF8(canonical(record without recordHash))); recursive sorted object keys, array order preserved, no LF in hash preimage. Every record binds previous hash and exact reconstructed counters.
rules.nonReset: Mandatory independently retained trusted checkpoint (count and tip hash), reconstructed transitions plus correlated sequence/history. Claims never seed counters; zero/reset/mismatch rejects. A bare hash chain cannot prove rollback resistance if an attacker can rewrite both log and trusted checkpoint.
rules.exclusiveLock: OS exclusive create wx before any reservation, PID + random ownership token + timestamp; in-process capability/file-content match required. Two real child-process contention tests. Stale/corrupt/abandoned lock STOP, no silent break or retry command.
rules.durability: Append one JSONL line and fsync while holding owned lock, then return checkpoint. Missing expected journal, torn writes, changed trusted tip or unacknowledged tail STOP. Not a WORM/power-loss or privileged-OS tamper-proof storage claim.
rules.reservationSemantics: SIMULATION_RESERVED before simulation; SIMULATION_COMPLETED before EXTEND_RESERVED; extend reserved before signing. Aborted simulation/fee STOP consumes simulation; failed/uncertain/expired/rejected-after-signing consumes extend permanently. Maximum3 each, distinct RUN/scope/owner gate.
rules.businessCap: At entry total18/consumed3/remaining15. Maintenance does not decrement business count. Optional separately reviewed business snapshot may decrease remaining with bundle hash/owner ref and total18, never increase/reset. Future authenticity adapter required.
rules.expiration: EXPIRED_NOT_INCLUDED needs original hash NOT_FOUND within retention covering firstPossibleLedger to observation, closeTime>maxTime, sequence=seqNum-1 at/after expiry ledger and complete later non-inclusion. Otherwise EXPIRED_UNRESOLVED; all outcomes consume reserved slot and STOP.
rules.uncertainty: Same original hash only; no rebroadcast/replacement. Eventual same-hash inclusion may update sequence but never clears owner-review STOP automatically.
rules.whitelistProvenance: Reviewed RUN/op IDs + exact battery/request + network-bound envelope hash + typed SUCCESS result + public signature/content verifier in captured mode + exact Battery/Request footprint + committed canonical bundle digest and immutable Git raw-file SHA256. SQL/deployment/manual key lists insufficient; historical/unrelated keys rejected.
rules.captureBoundary: Synthetic mode is unsigned and cannot pass captured-review signature checks. Captured verification reuses existing opaque ledger-header handling; no unsupported SDK-header decode or validator-grade inclusion claimed. Authenticated live capture/committed fresh RUN evidence still required.
rules.broadcastBoundary: Separate future gate only: persist-before-send, final sequence check, original-hash reconciliation; changed sequence -> reviewed resolution, never auto-reprepare.

knownOperationalPrerequisites: Operational provider/OS-principal/ACL two-way access denials are NOT proven or provisioned.
Independently retained non-rollback checkpoint/append-only acknowledgement service must be selected and proven before live use; local fsync is not WORM.
Future RPC/Horizon freshness, complete account history, creation/S0 and committed fresh RUN capture authenticity are not proven by supplied JSON labels.
Real creation/funding, simulation, signing/final source sequence/broadcast remain separately authorized gates; no implementation or execution authority here.
